query: Which operational controls (referral limits, stratified invitation rates, quota caps) and real-time dashboard indicators will best detect and mitigate referral, non-response, and disciplinary biases?

response.query: Which operational controls (referral limits, stratified invitation rates, quota caps) and real-time dashboard indicators will best detect and mitigate referral, non-response, and disciplinary biases?
response.answer: Operational controls like referral limits and quota caps, along with real-time dashboard indicators for response rates, help detect and mitigate biases in referrals and disciplinary actions.
